title: Brain Network (hard)
statementMd:
Breaking news from zombie neurology! It turns out that – contrary to previous beliefs – every zombie is *born* with a single brain, and only later it evolves into a complicated brain structure. In fact, whenever a zombie consumes a brain, a new brain appears in its nervous system and gets immediately connected to one of the already existing brains using a single brain connector. Researchers are now interested in monitoring the brain latency of a zombie. Your task is to write a program which, given a history of evolution of a zombie's nervous system, computes its brain latency at every stage.

## Input

The first line of the input contains one number $*n*$ – the number of brains in the final nervous system ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200000$). In the second line a history of zombie's nervous system evolution is given. For convenience, we number all the brains by $1, 2, ..., *n*$ in the same order as they appear in the nervous system (the zombie is born with a single brain, number $1$, and subsequently brains $2, 3, ..., *n*$ are added). The second line contains $*n* - 1$ space-separated numbers $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$, meaning that after a new brain $*k*$ is added to the system, it gets connected to a parent-brain ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c76b6d3543382cd0da515db077f6ef827c20b676.png).

## Output

Output $*n* - 1$ space-separated numbers – the brain latencies after the brain number $*k*$ is added, for $*k* = 2, 3, ..., *n*$.
statementZhMd:
僵尸神经学界传来最新消息！事实证明——与此前的认知相反——每只僵尸在*出生*时都只有一个大脑，之后才会逐渐进化成复杂的大脑结构。实际上，每当一只僵尸吞食一个大脑时，它的神经系统中就会出现一个新的大脑，并通过一条大脑连接器立即连接到某个已经存在的大脑上。研究人员现在希望监测僵尸的大脑延迟。你的任务是：给定一只僵尸神经系统的进化历史，计算它在每个阶段的大脑延迟。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个数 $*n*$——最终神经系统中的大脑数量（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 200000$）。第二行给出僵尸神经系统的进化历史。为方便起见，我们按照大脑出现在神经系统中的顺序，将所有大脑编号为 $1, 2, ..., *n*$（僵尸出生时拥有一个编号为 $1$ 的大脑，之后依次加入编号为 $2, 3 ..., *n*$ 的大脑）。第二行包含 $*n* - 1$ 个以空格分隔的数 $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$，表示在新大脑 $*k*$ 被加入系统后，它会连接到一个父大脑 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c76b6d3543382cd0da515db077f6ef827c20b676.png)。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n* - 1$ 个以空格分隔的数——在加入编号为 $*k*$ 的大脑后，大脑的延迟，其中 $k=2, 3, ..., *n*$。
